# scylladbcloud_cluster_requests (Data Source)

The requests (create, resize, delete and others) of a cluster.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "scylladbcloud_cluster_requests" "example" {
	cluster_id = 1337
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `cluster_id` (Number) Cluster ID.

### Optional

- `status` (String) Only requests in this status, e.g. IN_PROGRESS.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `requests` (List of Object) Requests. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--requests))

<a id="nestedatt--requests"></a>
### Nested Schema for `requests`

Read-Only:

- `progress_description` (String)
- `progress_percent` (Number)
- `request_id` (Number)
- `status` (String)
- `type` (String)
